anomalies.observed: The 0Ω serial-mode bridge jumper R3 has its left terminal on NET0027 (the PWM1 net) and its right terminal on the J4 pin-3 signal node; the MAX3485 serial-bus net NET0016 is not connected to J4 pin 3.
anomalies.expected: R3 (spec R13/R14) should bridge the MAX3485 serial bus (NET0016) to J4 pin 3, with the PWM1 net reaching J4 pin 3 only through the 1k series resistor R4.

evidence.quote: NET0027 label immediately left of R3 (0Ω) at the J4 servo-header signal node; annotation 'Short R13, R14 for Serial Servo'
R13, R14 | 0 Ω (jumpers) | When shorted, bridge J3-pin3 and J8-pin3 together and onto the MAX3485 TTL bus

anomalies.impact: In serial mode the ch-1 servo header (J4) is not driven by the MAX3485 bus, so the pan servo cannot be addressed; in PWM mode the 0Ω R3 bypasses the 1k series resistor R4.

parsed.summary: The schematic largely matches the specification, but the 0Ω serial-mode bridge jumper R3 appears to be tied to the PWM1 net NET0027 instead of the MAX3485 serial bus NET0016, which would break serial-mode control of the ch-1 servo header.
